title: How Humans Learn Unfamiliar Worlds: A Think-Aloud Dataset on ARC-AGI-3
abstract: arXiv:2610.34523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning through exploration and using newly acquired knowledge to achieve goals are central capabilities of general intelligence. Understanding these capabilities requires tracing how learners build, use, and revise world models during interaction. We construct the first dataset that records how humans discover and use the mechanisms of novel environments, using ARC-AGI-3 as a testbed: 144 trajectories from 64 participants across 25 public games, each pairing time-synchronized actions with think-aloud audio, plus 250 trajectories from large language model (LLM) agents with and without harnesses on the same games. We annotate mechanism triggers and recognition, action purposes, and errors and recovery, linking changes in understanding to the observations and actions that support them. We analyze characteristics of human cognition and compare them with those of LLM agents. Both groups anticipate mechanisms and use familiar analogies. Qual

translated_title: 人类如何学习陌生世界：基于ARC-AGI-3的出声思维数据集
translated_abstract: 通过探索进行学习，并运用新获得的知识来实现目标，是通用智能的核心能力。理解这些能力需要追踪学习者在交互过程中如何构建、使用和修正世界模型。我们构建了首个记录人类如何发现并使用全新环境机制的数据集，并以ARC-AGI-3作为测试平台：数据包含64名参与者在25个公开游戏中的144条轨迹，每条轨迹将时间同步的操作与出声思维音频配对；此外还包括大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在同一批游戏上、有无辅助框架（harness）两种条件下的250条轨迹。我们对机制的触发与识别、操作的目的、错误与恢复进行了标注，将理解的变化与支持这些变化的观察和操作关联起来。我们分析了人类认知的特征，并将其与LLM智能体的特征进行对比。两类主体都会预判机制并运用熟悉的类比。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文构建了首个记录人类在ARC-AGI-3陌生游戏环境中探索学习过程的出声思维数据集，通过标注机制发现、操作目的与错误恢复，实现了对人类认知与LLM智能体探索策略的对比分析。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first think-aloud dataset capturing how humans discover and use mechanisms in novel ARC-AGI-3 environments, with annotations of mechanism recognition, action purposes, and error recovery, enabling direct comparison between human cognition and LLM agents in exploratory learning.
